comparison.objective: Register an aluminium workpiece accurately against an L-shaped corner stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Cross-workspace handoff, planar placement, squaring, and contact registration against two faces.
comparison.success_condition: Block flat, all gaps at most 1 mm, sides within 2 degrees of square, and still for one second.
comparison.reason: Precision placement against datum faces is different from manipulating and locking a damper setting and validating its dynamic behavior.
